selection: Existing KITTI07-selected plane check and elevation correction transferred unchanged;00 influenced the earlier diagnosis and is not held out. No reselection on these failure sequences.
scope: Continuous natural full-sequence passive solver observation, with full trace-off/on parity controls. No forced pose, GT-fed solver, diagnostic-window restart, acceleration, retry gate, estimator change, new accuracy improvement claim or NCLT claim.
execution: Fresh Release runner and existing paper/serializer tests. For each sequence: official fetch, hash against prior committed official inputs, full off then full on using same binary/settings/thread environment, byte-equal saved poses and matching accuracy/frame fields, existing structural checker, conditioning analyzer and saved-step diagnostics; rehash and delete only owned scans before advancing. Failures retain raw files/receipts and block advancement.

archival.format: Deterministic gzip shards; concatenate decompressed shards in order to recover original bytes. Large JSONL files may split within a line, so parse only the reconstructed stream.
archival.validation: Retain original file SHA256/size, per-shard gzip SHA256/size and uncompressed chunk SHA256; stream-decompress every shard and verify the complete original hash before publication.

evidence_order: Commit source and protocol before running. Commit complete raw sequence evidence and commands before numerical prose. One results/diagnosis PR after the collection milestone, not a preparation-only tooling PR.
completion: All three full trace tuples and off/on controls exit0, complete validated traversal with no skipped KITTI inputs, all iterations retained, verified owned-input cleanup, committed raw evidence and motion/solver diagnostics with explicit limitations; required generators/regressions/preservation and final-head CI pass.
limits: Full rank/high support does not prove correct associations or motion. Origin-dependence controls establish a property, not a KITTI cause. Correlation of failures with stage decisions/spectra does not establish causality. Fixed pose-index block errors are not official KITTI distance-segment RTE. Recording overhead is not a speed result.
